local resizing = false
local dragStart
local startSize

ResizeHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        resizing = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startSize = MainFrame.Size
    end
end)

userInput.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if resizing and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local newSizeX = math.max(300, startSize.X.Offset + delta.X)
        local newSizeY = math.max(250, startSize.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, newSizeX, 0, newSizeY)
    end
end)

userInput.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        resizing = false
    end
end)

            local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", root)
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", root)
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            bg.P = 15000
            
            while flying and char and root and hum.Parent do
                runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
                
                if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                    local localMove = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(moveDir)
                    bv.Velocity = (camera.CFrame.LookVector * -localMove.Z + camera.CFrame.RightVector * localMove.X) * flySpeed
                else
                    bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end
                
                bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
            end
            bv:Destroy() bg:Destroy()
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        end)
    end
end)

            local h = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
            if espActive then
                if not h then h = Instance.new("Highlight", p.Character) end
                h.FillColor = espColor
            elseif h then h:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end

features:
Fly Mode: Allows free movement through the air with adjustable speed controls.
 Noclip: Enables walking through walls and solid objects by disabling collision detection.
 ESP (Extra Sensory Perception): Highlights other players on the map with customizable colors (Yellow, Red, Green, Purple).
 Speed & Jump Modifiers: Customizable custom walk speed and jump power settings.
 Player List & Utilities: Displays active players with options to teleport to them, view their camera perspective, or reset the view.
 Feedback System: Integrated Discord webhook form to send messages and feedback directly from the UI with a custom notification popup.
 Theme Customization: Ability to change the primary UI accent color (Yellow, Red, Blue, Purple).
 Settings & Admin Integration: Includes an option to load external admin commands and script hubs like Infinite Yield.
 Resizable & Draggable UI: Modern, mobile-friendly design featuring a draggable main window, collapsible toggle button, and interactive resizing handle.
